```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(MASS)
```


```{r}
###############################################
## 0. Load sample metrics
###############################################

if (!exists("sample_metrics_full")) {
  data <- read.csv("Outputs/dvg_sample_metrics.csv", sep = ",", header = TRUE)
} else {
  data <- sample_metrics_full
}

# Ensure numeric types
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    TCID50 = as.numeric(TCID50),
    Copy.Number = as.numeric(Copy.Number),
    DVG_count = as.numeric(DVG_count),
    mean_length = as.numeric(mean_length),
    BP_entropy = as.numeric(BP_entropy),
    total_support = as.numeric(total_support),
    Host = as.factor(Host)
  )


# Log transforms for y variables
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    log10_TCID50 = log10(TCID50),
    log10_CopyNumber = log10(Copy.Number)
  )

# Pseudocount for count so log scale works if any zeros
rich_pseudo <- 0.3
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    DVG_count_plot = ifelse(DVG_count <= 0, rich_pseudo, DVG_count),
    log10_DVG_count_plot = log10(DVG_count_plot)
  )

###############################################
## 1. Spearman correlations (overall)
###############################################

corr_fun <- function(x, y) {
  ok <- complete.cases(x, y)
  ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(x[ok], y[ok], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
  list(rho = unname(ct$estimate), p = ct$p.value, n = sum(ok))
}

metrics <- c("DVG_count", "mean_length", "BP_entropy")
yvars   <- c("TCID50", "Copy.Number")

corr_results <- expand.grid(
  Measure = metrics,
  Outcome = yvars,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

corr_results <- corr_results %>%
  mutate(
    rho       = mapply(function(m, y) corr_fun(data[[m]], data[[y]])$rho,
                       Measure, Outcome),
    p_value   = mapply(function(m, y) corr_fun(data[[m]], data[[y]])$p,
                       Measure, Outcome),
    n_complete = mapply(function(m, y) corr_fun(data[[m]], data[[y]])$n,
                       Measure, Outcome)
  )


# Write report
output_file <- "Outputs/DVG_vs_TCID50_CopyNumber_spearman_results.txt"
if (!dir.exists("Outputs")) dir.create("Outputs")

sink(output_file)
cat("Spearman correlation results (overall, all samples)\n")
cat("-------------------------------------------------\n\n")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(corr_results))) {
  cat(
    corr_results$Outcome[i], "vs", corr_results$Measure[i],
    "rho =", round(corr_results$rho[i], 3),
    "p =", format.pval(corr_results$p_value[i], digits = 3),
    "n =", corr_results$n_complete[i],
    "\n"
  )
}
sink()

write.csv(corr_results,
          "Outputs/DVG_vs_TCID50_CopyNumber_spearman_results.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

cat(paste("Results saved to", output_file, "\n"))
```

PLOTS

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(MASS)

###############################################
## 1. Load data
###############################################

data <- read.csv("Outputs/dvg_sample_metrics.csv", sep = ",", header = TRUE)

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    SampleID    = as.character(SampleID),
    Host        = as.factor(Host),
    TCID50      = as.numeric(TCID50),
    Copy.Number = as.numeric(Copy.Number),
    DVG_count   = as.numeric(DVG_count),
    mean_length = as.numeric(mean_length),
    BP_entropy  = as.numeric(BP_entropy)
  )

###############################################
## 2. Plot aesthetics (Prism-like)
###############################################

plot_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold", color = "black",
                                margin = margin(t = 15)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold", color = "black",
                                margin = margin(r = 15)),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line(size = 1, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(size = 1, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(5, "pt"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 20, b = 5, l = 5)
  )

cols <- c(
  "BALBF" = "#f94040",
  "BALBM" = "#0000FF",
  "BL6F"  = "#C5944E",
  "BL6M"  = "#0F99B2"
)
shapes <- c(
  "BALBF" = 1,
  "BALBM" = 22,
  "BL6F"  = 16,
  "BL6M"  = 15
)

###############################################
## 3. Comparison lists
###############################################

tcid50_comparisons <- list(
  list(x = "DVG_count",   xlab = "Unique DVGs",   y = "TCID50", ylab = expression(bold(TCID[50]))),
  list(x = "mean_length", xlab = "Mean DVG length",    y = "TCID50", ylab = expression(bold(TCID[50]))),
  list(x = "BP_entropy",  xlab = "Breakpoint entropy", y = "TCID50", ylab = expression(bold(TCID[50])))
)

copy_comparisons <- list(
  list(x = "DVG_count",   xlab = "Unique DVGs",   y = "Copy.Number", ylab = "Copy number"),
  list(x = "mean_length", xlab = "Mean DVG length",    y = "Copy.Number", ylab = "Copy number"),
  list(x = "BP_entropy",  xlab = "Breakpoint entropy", y = "Copy.Number", ylab = "Copy number")
)

###############################################
## 4. Regression helpers
###############################################

fit_global_regression <- function(df, xvar, yvar) {
  df2 <- df %>% filter(is.finite(.data[[xvar]]), .data[[yvar]] > 0)
  formula <- as.formula(paste0("log10(", yvar, ") ~ ", xvar))
  MASS::rlm(formula, data = df2)
}

predict_line <- function(model, df, xvar) {
  xs <- seq(min(df[[xvar]], na.rm = TRUE),
            max(df[[xvar]], na.rm = TRUE),
            length.out = 200)
  newdata <- data.frame(x = xs)
  names(newdata) <- xvar
  preds <- predict(model, newdata = newdata)
  tibble(x = xs, y = 10^preds)
}

###############################################
## 5. Split-axis plotting function
###############################################

make_split_plot <- function(df, xvar, yvar, xlab, ylab,
                            upper_range, lower_range,
                            upper_breaks, lower_breaks,
                            upper_labels = NULL,
                            lower_labels = NULL,
                            lod = NULL,
                            height_ratio = c(9,1)) {

  df <- df %>% filter(.data[[yvar]] > 0)

  model   <- fit_global_regression(df, xvar, yvar)
  regline <- predict_line(model, df, xvar)

  ############################################################
  ## Construct upper y-scale safely
  ############################################################
  if (!length(upper_breaks)) {
    upper_scale <- scale_y_log10(limits = upper_range, breaks = NULL, labels = NULL)
  } else if (is.null(upper_labels)) {
    upper_scale <- scale_y_log10(limits = upper_range,
                                 breaks = upper_breaks,
                                 labels = upper_breaks)
  } else {
    upper_scale <- scale_y_log10(limits = upper_range,
                                 breaks = upper_breaks,
                                 labels = upper_labels)
  }

  ############################################################
  ## Construct lower y-scale safely
  ############################################################
  if (!length(lower_breaks)) {
    lower_scale <- scale_y_log10(limits = lower_range, breaks = NULL, labels = NULL)
  } else if (is.null(lower_labels)) {
    lower_scale <- scale_y_log10(limits = lower_range,
                                 breaks = lower_breaks,
                                 labels = lower_breaks)
  } else {
    lower_scale <- scale_y_log10(limits = lower_range,
                                 breaks = lower_breaks,
                                 labels = lower_labels)
  }

  ############################################################
  ## TOP PANEL
  ############################################################
  p_top <- ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]],
                          color = Host, shape = Host)) +
    geom_point(size = 4, stroke = 1) +
    geom_line(data = regline, aes(x = x, y = y),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 1, color = "black") +
    upper_scale +
    scale_color_manual(values = cols) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = shapes) +
    plot_theme +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x  = element_blank(), 
      #To make this the dashed line: axis.line.x = element_line(size = 1, color = "black", linetype = "dotted")
      #To make it disappear: axis.line.x  = element_blank()
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      plot.margin  = margin(b = 10, t = 5, r = 15) #t = top margin r = right margin b = bottom margin (l = left margin
    ) +
    labs(y = ylab)

  ## ADD dashed line to upper panel
  if (!is.null(lod)) {
    p_top <- p_top +
      geom_hline(yintercept = lod,
                 linetype = "dotted",
                 linewidth = 1,
                 color = "black")
  }

  ############################################################
  ## BOTTOM PANEL
  ############################################################
  p_bottom <- ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]],
                             color = Host, shape = Host)) +
    geom_point(size = 4, stroke = 1.2) +
    geom_line(data = regline, aes(x = x, y = y),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 1, color = "black") +
    lower_scale +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(6)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cols) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = shapes) +
    plot_theme +
    theme(
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      plot.margin  = margin(t = 0, b = 5, r = 15)
    ) +
    labs(x = xlab)

  ############################################################
  ## Combine panels safely
  ############################################################
  p_final <- p_top / p_bottom +
    plot_layout(
      heights = height_ratio,
      guides = "collect"
    ) &
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  return(p_final)
}

###############################################
## 6. TCID50 plots
###############################################

if (!dir.exists("Images/Correlations"))
  dir.create("Images/Correlations", recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r}
for (comp in tcid50_comparisons) {

  p <- make_split_plot(
    df = data,
    xvar = comp$x,
    yvar = "TCID50",
    xlab = comp$xlab,
    ylab = comp$ylab,

    upper_range  = c(1e3, 1e7),
    lower_range  = c(0.5, 2),

    upper_breaks = c(1e3, 1e4, 1e5, 1e6, 1e7),
    lower_breaks = c(),

    upper_labels = c("10³","10⁴","10⁵","10⁶","10⁷"),    # useful superscripts: ⁰¹²³⁴⁵⁶⁷⁸⁹ "10³","10⁴","10⁵","10⁶","10⁷, ""10⁸","10⁹","10¹⁰"
    lower_labels = c(),

    lod = 1000,            # drawn on TOP panel
    height_ratio = c(9,1)
  )

  ggsave(
    paste0("Images/Correlations/TCID50_", comp$x, ".png"),
    p, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
  )
  
    ggsave(
    paste0("Images/Correlations/TCID50_", comp$x, ".svg"),
    p, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
  )
}
```
